destination.name: Yangzhou
destination.tagline: A Grand Canal city of salt merchants' gardens, slender lakes and old-quarter lanes
destination.description: Yangzhou has a history of over 2,500 years and grew as a trading centre for salt, rice and silk. It stands on flat land just north of the Yangtze and is criss-crossed by canals, including the old Grand Canal beside the city centre. Qing salt merchants left private gardens such as Geyuan and He Garden, and the narrow Slender West Lake winds through parkland northwest of the centre. The outline of the Ming city wall is still traced by canals around an old core about two kilometres square.
whyVisit: Follow canals through the old city
Wander the lanes of the old quarter

goodToKnow.title: Tickets change by season
goodToKnow.detail: Slender West Lake cost 100 yuan in Mar–May and Sep–Nov and 30 in Dec–Jan (2018). The city's gardens also price by season.

goodToKnow.title: Two train stations
goodToKnow.detail: Yangzhoudong, 7 km east of the centre, takes only high-speed trains. Yangzhou Station, 7 km west, also serves conventional trains.

goodToKnow.title: Buses stop early
goodToKnow.detail: City buses cost about ¥2, but many routes end around 18:00–19:00. Shared bikes are everywhere and old-town pedicabs run the narrow alleys.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Go in {months} for mild days, with highs of 15 to 28°C and far less rain than the wet summer.
